lines.text: King Zedekiah says Jeremiah is in their hands, and they lower him with ropes into a cistern with no water, only sand.
Zedekiah meets Jeremiah at the third entrance to the LORD's house and says he fears Pharaoh's soldiers.

wrong_details.true: Jews who have deserted to the Chaldeans

lines.text: Jeremiah tells the officials the king's words, and he remains in the courtyard of the guard until Jerusalem is captured.
